1.hint: Arrows move Sol, WASD moves Luna. Your own pool is safe. A plate works while you stand on it. A lever stays put.

2.hint: Your plates and levers open the other tower. A lever turns on when you walk right through it, off when you walk left.

3.hint: Black pools are shade: they kill you both. Every drop is one way, so look where your door is before you jump.

4.hint: You cannot drive the lift you stand on. Your partner's plate moves it.

5.hint: Raised bridges cover a pool while their plate is held. Your pools mark your way round.

6.hint: Push the crate off ledges to bring it down. Stuck against a wall? Lean on it, then jump into its corner.

7.hint: Ferries cross the chasm. You can't drive the one you stand on. Don't fall: the chasm is full of shade.

8.hint: Everything you learned this chapter, once each.

9.hint: One colour moves two lifts: one goes up as the other comes down. A weight left on the far end of a sunk lift keeps it down.

10.hint: A crate dropped in a pool is a stepping stone, but it lands right where it falls. Ferries carry crates too.

11.hint: Stand in a pit to hold a plate. Your partner has the lever that lifts its floor, and you with it.

12.hint: A crate down a chute stays on its plate for good. Read the colours before you push.

13.hint: Walk right through a lever to switch it on, left to switch it off. Which way you go round decides how it ends.

14.hint: A crate cannot climb, and a lift needs someone on its plate. Take the crate all the way up.

15.hint: One of you works the levers, the other runs. Walk through a lever to flip it, jump over it to leave it alone.

16.hint: Every arm holds a machine you have met. Each one opens the next: find the order.

17.hint: Your partner raises your stepping stones. The tunnels are too low to jump: wait for the stone.

18.hint: Several controls open one door and shut another. Where two gates stand together, run the moment your partner moves.

19.hint: A crate cannot cross on its own legs. Send it over, then go round to meet it.

20.hint: Sun water is safe for Sol and moon water for Luna. Every gate you meet is opened by your partner, far away.

21.hint: Hold a ferry's plate and it swings across; let go and it swings back. You cannot ride the ferry you are holding.

22.hint: One of you works the deck, the other runs the course. Then swap: it will not go the same way twice.

23.hint: Each wing mirrors the other, even the levers. What you do on your side changes theirs. The two yellow lifts balance each other.

24.hint: The spiral winds in to the doors. One of you works the levers while the other runs; then swap.

25.hint: The crates are your keys, and a crate never climbs. One of them has to be a step before it is a key.

26.hint: Purple and green make four codes; each code opens one crossing. Walk right through a lever to turn it on, left to turn it off, and jump over it to leave it.

27.hint: Each lift is worked from the other side. Same colour, same moment: when your partner presses, everything of that colour moves. The crate must reach the chute.

28.hint: Every corner opens one lock. Use each crate before you send it down to the vault.

29.hint: Every drop is one way. Whoever goes down first needs a white plate held to come back up.

30.hint: Your paths cross four times. At each crossing one of you holds the way for the other. In an airlock, run the moment your partner steps on.

31.hint: One lever below changes the room above. You may have to go back down and set it right.

32.hint: The heart opens only when both crates sit in their sockets and both levers are set.
